title: Coarse Layout Guard - Fix VUID-09600 Layout Validation Errors
description: Successfully eliminated coarse density image layout validation errors (VUID-09600) by implementing consistent layout management and preventing mip generation thrashing

technical_summary.problem: VUID-09600 validation errors: descriptor writes specified VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL but mips 1-6 were in VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, causing layout mismatches during sampling
technical_summary.root_cause: Two issues: (1) Mip generation running every frame, constantly changing layouts; (2) Initial image creation put all mips in SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL while descriptors expected GENERAL
technical_summary.solution: Implemented per-mip layout tracking, prevented repeated mip generation, and ensured consistent GENERAL layout for all mips

core_changes: Added per-mip layout tracking with std::vector<VkImageLayout> m_coarseMipLayouts
Added descriptor layout tracking with VkImageLayout m_coarseDescriptorLayout
Prevented mip generation from running every frame using m_coarseMipsGenerated flag
Modified initial image creation to transition all mips to GENERAL layout
Updated updateCoarseDensityGrid to use tracked descriptor layout

mip_generation_throttling.issue: generateCoarseMipChain called every frame in Application.cpp:592
mip_generation_throttling.fix: Added needsCoarseMipGeneration() check to run only once
mip_generation_throttling.result: Eliminated constant layout thrashing of mips 1-6

initial_layout_consistency.issue: All mips initialized to SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL but descriptors expect GENERAL
initial_layout_consistency.fix: Changed createCoarseDensityGrid final transition from SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL to GENERAL
initial_layout_consistency.result: All mips start in correct layout matching descriptor expectations

layout_tracking.issue: No visibility into actual vs expected layouts per mip
layout_tracking.fix: Added comprehensive layout tracking and debug output
layout_tracking.result: Clear visibility into layout states and transitions

before.vuid_09600_mips: PRESENT on mips 1, 2, 3+ - expected GENERAL vs actual SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
before.mip_generation: Running every frame causing constant layout transitions
before.split_rendering: Half point sprites, half mesh shader due to validation errors

after.vuid_09600_mips: ELIMINATED for mips 1-6 - all mips consistently in GENERAL layout
after.layout_consistency: Descriptor layout matches actual subresource layout
after.split_rendering: Resolved - unified mesh shader rendering working

VolumeRenderer.cpp.createCoarseDensityGrid: Changed final transition to GENERAL, added layout tracking initialization
VolumeRenderer.cpp.updateCoarseDensityGrid: Use tracked descriptor layout instead of hardcoded GENERAL
VolumeRenderer.cpp.generateCoarseMipChain: Added early exit if already generated, improved layout tracking
VolumeRenderer.cpp.extractIsoSurfaceShells: Use tracked layout for transitions, update tracking after transitions

Application.cpp.mip_generation_throttling: Added needsCoarseMipGeneration() check to prevent every-frame execution

debug_output_added: CR 1028: Using descriptor layout X for coarse density grid
CR 1028: Initialized X mips to GENERAL layout
CR 1028: Shell extraction - transitioning mip 0 from layout X to TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL
CR 1028: Updated mip 0 layout tracking to GENERAL after shell extraction
CR 1028: Skipping mip generation - already completed with stable layouts
